# Play — Twelve Pieces

- SudokuPad: [Twelve Pieces on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Twelve Pieces on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed), including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Every rule is native: killer cages (`killercage`) and anti-king (`antiking: true`). The pieces' pale colours are exported
as cell colours. I have not opened the links in a browser. If anything looks off, use `grid.svg` in this folder as the
reference picture.

Killer cages (piece = total: cells): F = 24: r7c4+r8c2+r8c3+r8c4+r9c3; I = 15: r5c5+r6c5+r7c5+r8c5+r9c5; L = 15: r3c1+r4c1+r4c2+r4c3+r4c4; N = 19: r1c5+r2c5+r2c6+r3c6+r4c6; P = 33: r5c3+r5c4+r6c3+r6c4+r7c3; T = 34: r4c7+r4c8+r4c9+r5c8+r6c8; U = 28: r7c1+r7c2+r8c1+r9c1+r9c2; V = 21: r7c7+r7c8+r7c9+r8c9+r9c9; W = 32: r1c1+r1c2+r2c2+r2c3+r3c3; X = 16: r1c8+r2c7+r2c8+r2c9+r3c8; Y = 29: r6c6+r7c6+r8c6+r8c7+r9c6; Z = 20: r1c3+r1c4+r2c4+r3c4+r3c5.

Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (constraints, solution).
